questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Rectify
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Amend**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Let us look into the meaning of the given words:

 
• **Rectify--** is to put right; correct. (अशुद्घ को शुद्घ करना)

 
 
• **Example**- *You should rectify your error before it is too late. *
 
 
 
• **Bend-**-shape or force (something straight) into a curve or angle. (झुकना)
 
 
• **Example**-* There was a slight bend in the river.*
 
 
 
• **Amend**--to alter, modify, rephrase, to correct. (संशोधन करना)
 
 
• **Example***- They voted to amend the law in 1920.* 
 
 
 
• **Raid-**-a rapid surprise attack on an enemy by troops (छापा, हमला)
 
 
• **Example**-* The bank robbers wore masks throughout the raid.*
 
 
 
• **Folly**--lack of good sense; foolishness. (मूर्खता)
 
 
• **Example**-* Events proved the folly of such calculations. *
 
 

The appropriate synonym of the given word** 'rectify' is ' amend'.**

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to ﬁll in the blank.**

He is addicted to alcohol and exerts a bad inﬂuence ______ his family.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**on**'.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

Let us look into the meaning of the given words:

__
 
• **On** indicates the minds of the people in his family ( **influence on his family)**
 
• **For** is used to show the duration of an action.—for 2 years
 
• **About **refers to the subject under discussion
 
• **In **is used with months of the year/seasons/countries.—in April / in Summer.

**The complete sentence is**--*He is addicted to alcohol and exerts a bad inﬂuence** on** his family.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Example sentence with '**on**'- 

 
 
• *A warm hand rested **on **her waist.*
 
• *I'll get supper **on **the table.*
 
 
 
• Example sentence with '**for**'-
 
 
• *They hadn't seen her in church **for **a while and they were worried about her.*
 
• *When they reached the house, she invited him in **for **a cup of coffee.*
 
 
 
• Example sentence with '**about**'- 
 
 
• *Do you want to tell me **about **it?*
 
• *In a few minutes, they had forgotten **about **the birds.*
 
 
 
• Example sentence with '**in**'- 
 
 
• *There is a big tree **in **the middle of the garden.*
 
• *He sits **in **the back of the car.*

questions.question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.**

He has deposits all his money in banks.
questions.solution:
**Option 3 is the right answer.**

The given sentence is in the **present perfect tense with 'has'.**

The format should be-- **'have' / 'has' + the past participle. **

The past participle is made by adding **'ed' to regular verbs [stay-stayed].**

So, the sentence should be--**'has deposited' instead of 'has deposits'.**

The correct sentence should be--*He **has deposited** all his money in banks. *
